tim_l: Heads up — quiet window starts 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. final roll plan: canary 10% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (10m). We need explicit pin confirmations for API, runtime, router, and console DB migration gating. @maria_g @raj_k
maria_g: Notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/3123459999 — includes user-impact section + migration steps. API pinned to v2.3.1 in router routing table. Console migration flagged as optional but we should pin to avoid vhost errors.
raj_k: Runtime build hash to pin: 9f7a3c2 (quant and batching change). Confirmed KV eviction toggle default remains off during canary. If token latency > 200ms p95 we abort.
alice_p: router team: router image 1.12.0-rc2 is ready. We will hold routing config until canary green. Will post config snippet here.
alice_p: ```
# router pin snippet
route: /api/*
backend: api-v2
weight_canary: 10
backend_pin: api-v2.3.1
```
deploy-bot: preflight checks started for thread 3123459999
deploy-bot: preflight result: PASS (service health ok, infra quotas ok, schema migration safe=YES)
oncall-sre: quick note — we'll watch redis evictions and kernel batching logs. Pager oncall if 5% error spike or >2s tail latency.
tim_l: rollback criteria (explicit): 1) end-to-end errors >1% for 5m; 2) latency p95 delta >200ms sustained 5m; 3) console 500s for admin flows. If any hit, immediate rollback to api-v2.3.0 + runtime previous hash.
maria_g: releasing release notes + short user DM for top 3 customers. will keep changelog minimal. :thumbsup:
raj_k: starting canary now. kicking off with router weight 10%. watchlist: /chat, /embed endpoints, kv cache hitrate.
deploy-bot: deploy step: set router weights -> set runtime pin 9f7a3c2 -> update console pins -> monitor (10m)
deploy-bot: canary started @3123459999. canary target 10% traffic. logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/streams/3123459999
alice_p: canary steady at 10% for 12m, errors 0.08%, p95 latency +12ms. moving to 50% in 30s.
oncall-sre: pushed additional sampling for kernel traces.
raj_k: 50% hold. still green. KV hit rate stable. proceeding to 100% in 10m unless anyone objects.
tim_l: go for 100%. final pin rollout command executed.
deploy-bot: rollout complete @3123460159 — all targets at pinned versions. Post-deploy smoke: PASS. If any regression, follow rollback criteria above.
